title: Resident Comfort Specialist Part Time
description:
$18/hour | Flexible Schedule | Meaningful Work

Greetings everyone. My name is Claire. I am posting here today with the hopes of meeting six people. The people who can be described as people with heart and people with passion but more on that in a minute.

You see, there is a story behind my work and this post and here it goes.

I am an educator and former school principal turned nurse, turned nurse entrepreneur and geriatric wellness expert. Yes, education was my first love and my second love is nursing.

If you ask my mother, she would tell you that I have never met a stranger.

I was that girl who would go down the street to find someone to help and would stop and carry the groceries for the elderly neighbor and feed all the stray cats and lonely dogs that I could find.

During nursing school, I developed a true inquiring mind, and I could not sit still because I was pulled by various areas of health care. I worked in a long-term care community and I soon became pulled by the emotional and psychosocial needs of most older adults who live in long term care.

Many of them are sad and although they are amongst others, many feel lonely and left behind. I made myself a promise that I would take interest in those older adults and find a way to make them smile and feel happy even if it was just for a short time.

Through all my work seasons as a former teacher, a school principal, a nurse, a clinical chaplain, and now, a nurse entrepreneur, one truth has never changed: people need human connection.

That’s why I started this program — to bring kindness, laughter, and companionship to older adults in nursing homes and long-term care centers.


So, here is where you come in. I am in search of people with heart, and people with passion. I call these people Resident Comfort Specialists, and their job is simple yet life-changing: to bring joy and comfort to someone who feels forgotten. The job is very simple and very fulfilling.

As a Resident Comfort Specialist, you might spend your day with a resident doing any or all of the following:

  • Reading or telling stories
  • Watching a favorite TV show together
  • Singing along to old songs
  • Decorating a small tabletop Christmas tree
  • Or simply sitting beside someone who needs company
And yes — you’ll be paid $18 an hour for this beautiful work. It’s a job that fills your heart as much as your bank account.

All you need are three things:

  1. A degree in compassion. This is supposed to make your laugh because there is no degree in Compassion. You just need to be kind and gentle.
  2. A clean background check
  3. Your ID and Social Security number (so we can pay you!)
We’ll introduce you to the care team at the facility, guide you through the process, and help you start making a difference right away.

If you’ve been looking for work that truly means something — this is it.
You’ll be paid to make someone smile.
And you’ll go home knowing you helped another human being feel seen, valued, and loved.

Come join our team of compassionate companions.
We can’t wait to meet you.

Please respond with a good phone number and an email that you check regularly

Thanks and wishing you a beautiful week ahead.

title: Full-Time Beauty Team Leader
description:
Role Specific Information

Job Description

About the Role

As Beauty Team Leader, you will lead the team to drive sales and department initiatives through an authentic passion for beauty and engage the team and clients by identifying their needs with a consultative approach. You will maintain expert knowledge of top beauty brands, execute merchandise sets and support replenishment and visual standards. You will guide the team to meet Sephora at Kohl’s standards and ensure an excellent overall client experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the Beauty Team to deliver a positive and compelling client experience

  • Provide leadership for the Beauty Team through strong partnership with the Store Manager

  • Build a strong culture within the department and team through executing recognition programs to reward client experience and sales, providing feedback and coaching

  • Act as a point of contact for Store Manager, Sephora Training Team, and other partners

  • Drive sales performance, understand and execute the sales plans and hold the team accountable to support and meet goals

  • Build and maintain client loyalty and influence clients by identifying their needs and suggesting products to drive sales, including the opportunity to upsell products

  • Provide credibility to the client through knowledge of products and beauty trends

  • Inspire clients through demonstrating products and application of products

  • Actively engage and complete all required training to expand knowledge and ensure the team completes all required training according to established timelines

  • Work with Store Manager and Sephora partners to identify and address any additional training opportunities needed for Beauty Advisors

  • Ensure all Sephora visual merchandising and operational standards are executed according to company guidelines and established timelines, including merchandise sets, tester maintenance and department cleanliness and hygiene standards

  • Ensure timely and consistent sales floor replenishment to drive sales and enhance the client experience

  • Support omni-processing within the department

  • Support inventory management from receipt to sale, including freight processing, back stocking, inventory counts and price changes

All associates are responsible for:

  • Acting with integrity and honesty and fostering teamwork in an engaged and inclusive culture

  • Exercising good judgment and discernment when making decisions; taking appropriate partners as needed

  • Supporting and executing safety and shortage reduction programs following company guidelines

  • Accomplishing multiple tasks within established timeframes

  • Following company policies, procedures, standards and guidelines

  • Maintaining adherence to company safety policies for the safety of all associates and customers

  • Receiving, understanding and proactively responding to direction from leaders and other company personnel

  • Other responsibilities as assigned

What Skills You Have

Required

  • Authentic passion for beauty

  • 5 years of Client-facing retail or service industry experience

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence in a clear and concise manner

  • Availability to work days, nights, weekends and holidays

Essential Functions

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you will be required to perform, however you may be required to perform additional functions. Kohl’s may revise this job description at any time. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

  • Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” Section.

  • Ability to satisfactorily complete company training programs.

  • Ability to comply with dress code requirements.

  • Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation.

  • Ability to operate and communicate on multiple frequency devices, handheld scanners, and other technology equipment as directed.

  • Ability to maintain prompt and regular attendance and meet scheduling requirements as set by the company.

  • Perform work in accordance with the Physical Requirements section.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. frequently and occasionally over 50 lbs. with a two person lift.

  • Ability to climb, squat, stoop, kneel, crouch, bend, twist, reach, lift, grasp, push and pull on a frequent basis.

  • Ability to stand/walk for the duration of a scheduled shift (at least 8 hours).

  • Ability to visually verify information and locate and inspect merchandise.

  • Ability to comply with health and safety standards

Pay Starts At: $19.20

title: Associate I, Production Operations
description:
Job Description

As a Remittance Processing Associate, you’ll support the accurate and timely processing of customer payments in our lockbox operation. You’ll prepare payments for processing, handle exception items, research adjustments, and help maintain remittance processing equipment and supplies. This is an on-site, overnight position in Bolingbrook, Illinois, and prior or current lockbox experience is required.


Location: 270 Remington Boulevard, Suite A & B, Bolingbrook, IL 60440
Schedule: Friday night to Monday night 9pm to 4:30 am, Tues, Wed and Thurs nights off.
Work arrangement: On-site


What you will be doing

  • Prepare customer payments for processing.
  • Coordinate setup and maintenance activities for remittance processing equipment.
  • Research and process adjustments.
  • Process exception items.
  • Maintain inventory of remittance processing supplies.
  • Prepare outgoing collection notices for clients.
  • Verify and distribute processing output.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What you bring

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Prior or current lockbox experience.
  • Knowledge of remittance and item processing procedures.
  • Ability to identify errors in calculations and balances.
  • Ability to organize, assemble, and sequence work efficiently.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work with computer processing systems and related equipment.
  • Ability to lift or move up to 30 pounds.
  • Ability to work the required overnight, on-site schedule.

What we offer you:

  • A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities
  • A modern, international work environment and a dedicated and motivated team
  • A competitive salary and benefits
  • A work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect
  • Varied and challenging work to help you grow your technical skillset

title: SAP Specialist, IT Solutions
location: Richardson County, Nebraska, United States; United States; Texas, United States
description:
Req ID: 137518
Region: Americas
Country: USA
State/Province: Texas
City: Richardson

Summary


The Specialist, IT Solutions (SAP) will engage with business functions to support, optimize, and maintain SAP ERP System across the enterprise. This role involves collecting and analyzing business requirements, participating in SAP initiatives, supporting system integrations, and providing user training. The specialist acts as a vital bridge between business stakeholders and the technical SAP delivery teams to ensure solutions meet operational goals.

Detailed Description


Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

•

Engage with business stakeholders to gather, document, and translate business requirements into functional specifications for SAP solutions.

•

Support configuration, testing, and implementation activities within SAP

•

Respond to system issues, analyze root causes, and work with internal IT teams or Application Management Services partners to deliver fixes.

•

Participate in SAP transformation projects through data validation, testing cycles, and cutover activities.

•

Provide system training and create user documentation/Standard Operating Procedures for end-users.

•

Support system integration tasks (EDI/ALE/IDocs, APIs) between SAP and local systems (e.g., PLM, MES, Data Warehouse).

•

Ensure compliance with IT governance, data management, and security standards.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies


• Good understanding of core business processes in manufacturing and supply chain (e.g., Order Management, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance).

•

Solid functional knowledge in at least one or two core SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, PP, SD, FICO, or WM).

•

Knowledge in the areas of Master Data, Production and Non-Production PR/PO, Scheduling Agreement, PIR, Release Strategy, ROP, Forecasting, IM, GR, GI, Scrap, Physical Inventory, Cycle Counting, Batch Management, Order Management, Shipping is a plus;

•

Good analytical, technical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

•

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into language that business users can understand.

•

Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) concepts, including Agile methodologies.

•

Experience in creating functional requirement documents (FRDs), test scripts, and process flowcharts.

•

Strong customer service orientation, teamwork, and communication skills.

Physical Demands


• Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

• Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Typical Experience


•

4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in SAP functional support, business systems analysis, or SAP configuration.

•

Participation in at least 1 or 2 full lifecycle SAP implementations or major enhancement projects.

•

Exposure to SAP is highly preferred.

•

Experience working in a manufacturing or supply chain environment is an asset.

Typical Education


•

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Computer Science, or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Notes


This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

Competitive Pay Based on Experience & Scheduled Hours

  • Part-Time: Starting at $19.50 per hour, with higher rates available based on experience, qualifications, and regularly scheduled hours.
  • Full-Time: $21.50–$25.50 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications, plus eligible benefits.

FREE Certification Training!

Interested in becoming a lifeguard or swim instructor? We'll provide certification training at no cost to qualified candidates who successfully pass the required tests.

A Meaningful Career

Help swimmers of all ages develop confidence, learn essential water safety skills, and enjoy everything our aquatic programs have to offer.

Variety in Your Workday

title: Actuary
description:
Company Description:


Aspida Re Services Ltd. (“Aspida Re Services”) is a Bermuda based service provider to Aspida’s reinsurance companies. Aspida Re Services provides annuity and life insurance companies with tailored risk management solutions, with a specialization in closed block and new business flow reinsurance of asset-intensive and interest rate-sensitive annuity and life insurance liabilities. Aspida Re Services has a dedicated team of 14 reinsurance professionals based Bermuda and Cayman responsible for reinsurance pricing, operations, and risk management. Aspida is backed by Ares Management Corporation, “Ares” (NYSE: ARES), which, through the Ares Insurance Solutions team, provides dedicated investment management, capital solutions and corporate development support. For more information, please visit aspidare.bm.


Aspida Re Services is seeking an Actuary to support Economic Balance Sheet (EBS) valuation for Bermuda and non-Bermuda entities included in Group reporting. Reporting to the Deputy Chief Actuary, the Actuary will contribute to quarterly and annual valuations, financial and regulatory reporting, forecasting, and strategic analysis, working closely with actuarial, finance, risk, and investment teams across the Group.


Who We Are:


Sometimes, a group of people come together and create something amazing. They don’t let egos get in the way. They don’t settle for the status quo, and they don’t complain when things get tough. Instead, they see a common vision for the future and each person makes an unspoken commitment to building that future together. That’s the culture, the moxie, and the story of Aspida.

Our business focuses on annuities and life insurance. At first, it might not sound flashy, but that’s why we’re doing things differently than everyone else in our industry. We’re dedicated to developing data-driven tech solutions, providing amazing customer experiences, and applying an entrepreneurial spirit to everything we do. Our work ethic is built on three main tenets: Get $#!+ Done, Do It with Moxie, and Have Fun. If this sounds like the place for you, read on, and then apply at aspida.com/careers.


What We Are Looking For:


Aspida Re Services is seeking an Actuary to support Economic Balance Sheet (EBS) valuation for Bermuda and non-Bermuda entities included in Group reporting. Reporting to the Deputy Chief Actuary, the Actuary will contribute to quarterly and annual valuations, financial and regulatory reporting, forecasting, and strategic analysis, working closely with actuarial, finance, risk, and investment teams across the Group.


What We Are Looking For:

  • Develop, maintain, and run actuarial valuation models, with appropriate data validations, reconciliations, and controls to support accurate and timely reporting.
  • Support quarterly and annual EBS valuations, including best estimate liabilities (BEL), risk margin, and technical provisions.
  • Prepare reserve rollforwards and analysis of movements, explaining the impact of business activity, market conditions, experience, and changes in assumptions or models.
  • Develop and enhance actuarial models for existing and new treaties, including cashflow projections and Scenario-Based Approach (SBA) modeling.
  • Support entity and Group regulatory filings, capital reporting, and responses to queries from regulators, auditors, and the Approved Actuary.
  • Contribute to forecasts, business plans, and sensitivity and scenario analysis to assess the impact of market movements, new business, and strategic initiatives on reserves and capital.
  • Participate in experience studies and assumption reviews, assess emerging trends, and document recommendations and impact of assumption changes.
  • Improve valuation processes through automation and stronger controls, maintain clear documentation of models, methodologies, assumptions, and model changes.
  • Manage competing priorities and deliver reporting, analysis, and special projects within agreed timeline.
  • Monitor relevant Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) developments and support the implementation of changes affecting entity and Group EBS reporting.

title: Trainer Senior, Client Learning
description:
Job Description

Every day at FIS, innovators, problem solvers, and changemakers work together to create technology that advances the world of finance. We embrace new ideas, challenge what's possible and empower our teams to make a lasting impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of fintech, unlock your next chapter with FIS.


About the Role

FIS is seeking a Trainer Senior to develop and deliver client learning programs supporting trust, custody and investment management services. In this role, you will translate complex financial-services processes, products and applications into practical learning experiences for financial institution clients and internal teams. You will assess learning needs; create and maintain training materials; and deliver instructor-led, virtual and digital learning that supports client adoption, operational effectiveness and evolving business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and deliver task- and job-based learning programs for trust, custody and investment management services, including instructor-led, virtual and digital learning experiences.
  • Conduct training needs assessments and select appropriate instructional strategies based on learner skill levels, business processes, job responsibilities and client objectives.
  • Create, customize and maintain presentations, training guides, job aids, tutorials and other learning resources, collaborating with subject matter experts to keep content accurate and current.
  • Deliver engaging client training in classroom and virtual environments, including standard, customized and train-the-trainer programs, and evaluate effectiveness through learner feedback and training outcomes.
  • Manage assigned training initiatives from planning through delivery, partnering with clients and internal teams to understand business needs, coordinate learning plans, address issues and continuously improve training effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience with wealth management, trust administration, custody and/or investment management operations within a financial institution or financial-services environment.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering instructor-led and virtual training, including strong presentation, facilitation, and classroom-management skills.
  • Experience conducting training needs assessments and applying adult-learning principles to develop instructional strategies and learning materials.
  • Experience creating and maintaining presentations, course materials, training guides, job aids, or other learning resources using standard workplace technology.
  • Strong client-service, communication, relationship-building, project-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate with subject matter experts and work independently.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting back-office wealth management processes and training on financial-services products, applications, or operational workflows.
  • Familiarity with instructional design methodologies, multimedia development tools, and digital learning approaches.
  • Experience customizing course content, supporting train-the-trainer programs, and using learner feedback or evaluation results to improve training.

The impact you’ll make

As a Trainer Senior, you will help clients build the practical knowledge and confidence needed to support trust, custody, and investment management operations. Through effective needs assessment, thoughtful course design, and engaging delivery, you will make complex processes and applications easier to understand and apply. Your collaboration with clients, subject matter experts and internal partners will help keep learning programs accurate, relevant, and responsive to changing client and business needs.


What We Offer You

At FIS, your career journey is yours to shape. We provide the tools, experiences, and support to help you reach what's next.

Here’s what else we offer:

  • Opportunities to make an impact in fintech
  • Internal career growth opportunities
  • Personal and professional learning
  • Inclusive, diverse work environment
  • Resources to give back to your community

title: Research & Development Labs Network Admin
location: Richardson County, Nebraska, United States; United States; Texas, United States
description:
10 - Technical Lead, IT Infrastructure
Req ID: 137477
Region: Americas
Country: USA
State/Province: Texas
City: Richardson

Summary


We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented RDL Network Administrator to manage the day-to-day operations and administration of our global Research and Development Lab (RDL) networks. Reporting directly to the Lead Network Architect, you will be responsible for the run-and-maintain aspects of our isolated, air-gapped networks across multiple HPS Design Center locations (including San Jose, Richardson, Thailand, Shanghai, SongShan Lake, Penang, Chennai, and future sites).

The ideal candidate will handle routing, switching, and firewall adjustments, manage user access, configure local jump hosts, and execute secure file transfers across air gaps. Since this environment operates under strict security isolation without typical enterprise automated management tools (e.g., Active Directory, automated endpoint agents), this role requires a hands-on, highly disciplined administrator who excels at executing manual and semi-automated workflows securely and consistently.

Core Responsibilities


1. Daily Network Operations & Maintenance

• Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor the health, performance, and uptime of all RDL hardware, including Checkpoint 3980 Firewalls, SilverPeak SD-WAN appliances, Cisco Catalyst 9400/9200 switches, and Celestica DS2000/ES1500 switches.

• Configuration Management: Implement localized VLAN adjustments, IP address allocations, and switch port provisioning to isolate multi-tenant projects as directed by the Network Architect.

• Routine Maintenance: Execute hardware diagnostics, physical cabling checks, and firmware/OS updates across network and server appliances following strict maintenance window guidelines.

2. Identity & Secure Access Administration

• User Onboarding & Management: Provision local user accounts and role-based permissions directly on Linux-based jump hosts. Manage access credentials in a strict, decentralized non-Active Directory environment.

• Remote Session Administration: Administer daily customer connections using CyberArk vPAM (Virtual Privileged Access Management) and internal user access using Zscaler ZTNA/Zscaler App Connectors.

• Security Audits: Review, audit, and clean up inactive user sessions and local accounts weekly to maintain strict security posture.

3. Data Transfer & Repository Sync Operations

• Multi-Tier Sync Execution: Execute and monitor the secure transfer of "transfer bundles" containing OS packages (Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, CentOS, etc.), drivers, and software libraries across the air gap.

• Local Repo Hosting: Ensure local web repositories (Apache/Nginx hosted at /var/www/html/repo/) are operational, indexed, and accessible to local lab systems.

• Integrity Validation: Verify the cryptographic hashes (SHA-256 checksums) of all data packages moving from the Global Repository Server to the RDL Local Repository Server.

4. Support Ticket Resolution & SLA Adherence

• End-User Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for HPS design engineers needing network troubleshooting, IP conflicts resolved, or new package requests.

• Ticketing Operations: Process, update, and resolve secure lab support tickets in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Escalation Point: Identify complex network issues or design deviation requests and escalate them directly to the Lead Network Architect.

5. Compliance & Clean Environment Enforcement

• Software Auditing: Conduct regular logical audits of systems within the RDL to ensure strictly banned corporate agents (e.g., CrowdStrike, Threat Locker, Big Fix, ServiceNow Agents, ClearPass NAC) are not installed.

• Asset Tracking: Maintain a flawless inventory of all HPS-owned assets inside the RDL physical rooms, including servers, switches, wireless access points (Aruba 755), and connected lab machines.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies


Required Technical Skills:

• Network & Security Hardware: Practical experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco switches (Catalyst/Nexus) and administering Checkpoint Firewalls (defining security rules, NAT, and logs).

• Linux System Administration: Mid-to-senior level competency in Linux (Rocky, CentOS, Ubuntu)—specifically user management, bash scripting, basic routing, and running local web servers (Apache/Nginx).

• Access Tools: Experience working with remote access tools such as Zscaler ZTNA / App Connectors and Privilege Access Management solutions (specifically CyberArk).

• Virtualization Basics: Solid experience administering VMs, clusters, and virtual switches within VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper-V environments.

• Air-Gap Protocols: Working knowledge of secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, SCP, rsync) and security scanning methodologies.Preferred

Certifications:

• CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)

• Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA)

• CompTIA Security+ or Linux+

• CyberArk Certified Trustee or Defender

Soft Skills & Working Style:

• High Operational Discipline: Ability to strictly adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) without cutting corners, even during urgent troubleshooting.

• Excellent Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, necessary for translating technical issues to designers and coordinating with corporate security teams.

• Multi-Tasker: Capable of balancing ticket requests from multiple global labs concurrently while maintaining accurate records.

Physical Demands


•

Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

•

Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Education & Experience


• Bachelor’s degree in Network Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• 4+ years of experience in network administration or system administration, preferably managing secure, segmented, or laboratory networks.

Notes

description:
About the Role

At Canner, we're building breakthrough AI and data infrastructure that transforms data from a static asset into the core engine of enterprise decision-making. As part of our R&D team, you'll help drive the development and adoption of Wren AI.

Wren AI is Canner's flagship open-source project, enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to query enterprise data directly and providing AI Agents with precise semantic query capabilities. Our open-source repository has been featured on GitHub Top Trending for several consecutive weeks, accumulating nearly 15k+ stars and establishing itself as a leading global GenBI solution — a strong signal of worldwide developer recognition and demand.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll be the engineer on the front line with our customers — deeply understanding their data architecture and business context, and turning Wren AI into the AI data infrastructure that powers their organization. You won't just respond to issues; you'll proactively drive customer success, channel frontline insights back to product, and accelerate our iteration cycle.

If you're passionate about large-scale AI applications, working with international enterprises, serving global users, and learning the standards and expectations of multinational customers, this is an exceptional opportunity to participate in cutting-edge industry development.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical partner and engineering point of contact for customers — understanding their data architecture, business needs, and use cases, and helping them plan and implement Wren AI best practices in their environment
  • Lead customer onboarding and deployment, including data source connections (databases, data warehouses, etc.), semantic model (MDL) design and tuning, and AI model configuration and validation
  • Design and build custom integrations, PoCs, demos, and technical validations tailored to each customer's data environment, demonstrating Wren AI's value in their specific context
  • Triage, diagnose, and resolve technical issues customers encounter with the Wren AI platform/API — including natural language query accuracy, SQL generation, chart/report rendering, and API integration challenges
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to translate customer needs and frontline insights into product issues and feature requests, and participate in testing fixes and validating new features
  • Write and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, best practices, FAQs, and solution templates to improve customer self-service and team-wide support efficiency
  • Track and respond to customer requests within SLA, ensuring high-quality and timely resolution
  • Analyze customer usage patterns and recurring issues to proactively propose product improvements and customer success strategies — improving product stability, user experience, and retention
  • Support Wren AI's open-source community growth and engagement — responding to GitHub issues/discussions, supporting community contributors, writing technical blog posts and example projects, and participating in community events to expand our global developer ecosystem

Requirements

Essential Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Information Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience with Python and/or Node.js — able to read and write code to understand product internals, debug issues, or build customer-facing integration scripts
  • Strong familiarity with databases and SQL — able to understand complex queries, performance issues, and optimization techniques
  • Experience with API integration, usage, and troubleshooting
  • Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written) — comfortable reading technical documentation and engaging with international customers
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; detail-oriented, patient, and able to handle complex or multi-threaded tasks independently while remaining composed in front of customers
  • Strong customer-facing mindset — enjoys direct customer interaction, understanding requirements, and proposing solutions
  • Willing to work flexible hours to support international customers across different time zones — including occasional evening or late-night meetings to align with customers in regions such as North America, Europe, or Southeast Asia
  • Willing to travel internationally as needed for customer on-site engagements, conferences, or partner meetings (estimated occasional travel, not frequent)

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) or GenBI / Text-to-SQL concepts and implementation
  • Experience working with cross-functional global teams or onboarding international customers

  • Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Customer Engineering, or similar customer-facing engineering roles

title: SAFETY & COMPLIANCE TECHNICIAN
description:
Position Summary
The Safety & Compliance Tech supports the implementation, coordination, and continuous improvement of workplace safety programs, regulatory compliance, and injury prevention initiatives within the manufacturing facility. This position works closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Human Resources, and plant leadership to identify hazards, promote safe work practices, and maintain compliance with OSHA and applicable company requirements.
This is a hands-on, highly visible role that requires an active presence on the production floor, strong employee engagement, and the ability to educate, coach, and reinforce safe work practices. The Tech will also provide limited support for environmental compliance activities, with primary focus remaining on employee safety and workplace injury prevention.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Support the implementation and ongoing improvement of facility safety programs and initiatives.
Serve as a safety resource for employees, supervisors, and plant leadership, providing guidance on safe work practices and company policy.
Maintain an active presence on the production floor through routine safety observations, inspections, audits, and hazard identification.
Assist in maintaining compliance with OSHA, state, local and company safety requirements.
Maintain accurate safety records, OSHA logs, inspection reports, training documentation, and other required compliance.
Coordinate and participate in investigations involving workplace injuries, near misses, property damage, and safety concerns. Assist with root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective actions.
Support and monitor key safety programs, including:

Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
Machine Guarding
Power Industrial Trucks
Fall Protection
Confined Space
Hot Work
Hazard Communication
PPE
Contractor Safety
Ergonomics
Emergency Preparedness

Coordinate and conduct employee safety training, new-hire safety onboarding, refresher training, and safety awareness activities.
Partner with operations, maintenance and engineering to identify and address safety concerns related to equipment, process, and workplace conditions.
Assist HR with workers’ compensation, injury documentation, and return-to-work activities as needed.
Support the company’s drug and alcohol-free workplace policy, including coordination of reasonable suspicion testing when required.
Participate in CGS Safety Council meetings, facility safety incentives and plant communication meetings.
Track safety observations, incidents, corrective actions, training completion, and safety performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
Promote employee involvement in safety initiatives and encourage timely reporting of hazards, unsafe conditions, and near misses.

Qualifications
Required

Associate’s degree in Occupational Safety, Industrial Technology, or Environmental Health & Safety or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 2-3 years of progressive safety experience in manufacturing or industrial environment.
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and general industrial safety practices.
Experience with conducting safety inspections, coordinating training, maintaining documentation, and supporting incident investigations.
Strong organizational, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and follow through on corrective actions.
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and maintaining accurate records and reports.

Preferred

Experience in glass fabrication, or similar industrial manufacturing environment.
OSHA 30-Hour General Industry certification or other relevant safety training.
Experience with workers’ compensation, return-to-work programs, and incident investigations.
Familiar with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement practices.
Basic understanding of environmental compliance requirements, including SWPPP and water usage documentation.

Key Expectations
The Safety & Compliance Tech is expected to be visible, approachable, and proactive safety resource who:

Regularly engages with employees on the production floor to identify hazards and reinforce safe work practices.
Builds positive working relationships with employees, supervisors and leadership.
Communicates safety concerns promptly and follow through to ensure corrective actions are addressed.
Encourages accountability for safety expectations through coaching, education, and consistent communication.
Balance regulatory requirements with practical solutions that support manufacturing operations.
Uses safety observations, incident trends, and employee feedback to recommend improvements.
Promotes employee participation and reinforces that safety is a shared responsibility across the facility.

Success in this role will be measured by active engagement on the production floor, timely hazard identification and resolution, completion of required safety inspections and training. Additional measures include accurate compliance documentation, effective corrective action follow-up, and increase employee safety awareness and participation.
The Safety & Compliance Tech will support a safe, compliant, and proactive workplace environment while helping strengthen the facility’s overall safety culture.

title: RDL Jump Host Admin
description:
​Specialist, IT Infrastructure
Req ID: 137495
Remote Position: Hybrid
Hiring Manager: Paul Stanners
Band: 08
Region: Asia
Country: Malaysia
State/Province: Bayan Lepas
City: Penang

Summary


We are seeking an experienced, compliance-driven RDL Jump Host Administrator to take ownership of the system administration, security, and access control of our global local jump hosts. Reporting directly to the Lead Network Architect, and working in close alignment with the RDL Network Administrator, you will manage secure access pathways into completely isolated, air-gapped lab networks across multiple HPS Design Centers (including San Jose, Richardson, Thailand, Shanghai, SongShan Lake, Penang, Chennai, and future sites).

The primary objective of this role is to ensure that remote connections terminating from corporate Zscaler ZTNA or customer CyberArk vPAM environments are securely processed, authenticated, and audited. Since our environments strictly prohibit Active Directory or domain joins, you will manage decentralized, local authentication configurations, shell environments, and session boundaries.

Crucially, you will implement and maintain the strict compliance frameworks required for Export Controlled VLANs—including interactive terms-of-use banners, mandatory user acceptance gates for shell access, and tamper-proof user-acceptance audit logging.

Core Responsibilities


1. Jump Host System Administration & Hardening

• Server Provisioning & Lifecycle: Deploy, configure, and maintain Linux-based (Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, CentOS) local jump host virtual machines operating on VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper-V clusters.

• Operating System Hardening: Apply strict CIS (Center for Internet Security) hardening benchmarks on all jump host operating systems. Ensure that no unauthorized software or corporate agents (e.g., CrowdStrike, ServiceNow, ClearPass, Windows Domain utilities) are installed or active on endpoints installed on the VLAN behind the Jump Host.

• Service Availability: Ensure the high availability, performance, patch status, and storage capacity of jump servers acting as gateways to the core RDL networks.

2. Export Control Compliance & Interactive Gates

• Export Control Shell Banners: Configure and manage interactive, mandatory user agreement screens (e.g., using custom shell login scripts, Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM), or SSH ForceCommand) specifically for systems accessing Export Controlled VLANs.

• User Acceptance Verification: Ensure that users cannot acquire an interactive shell, run commands, or bypass the landing screen without explicitly reading and accepting the export control and NDA terms.

• Tamper-Proof Acceptance Logging: Implement and maintain robust, structured logging systems (using Rsyslog, Journald, or custom secure local logging scripts) that capture:

• The authenticated user's local/remote identifier.

• Source IP and connection timestamp.

• Explicit timestamped confirmation of the user's compliance acceptance.

• Log Archival & Integrity: Set up secure, write-only log forwarding or local hashing protocols to ensure audit logs of export-control acceptances cannot be modified or deleted by general users.

3. Identity, Access, & Session Management

• Decentralized Local Authentication: Programmatically or manually provision local Unix user accounts, localized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and SSH keys on all jump hosts.

• Remote Integration Support: Partner with corporate IT to ensure seamless hand-offs from Zscaler ZTNA (via local Zscaler App Connectors) and CyberArk vPAM sessions terminating on the jump hosts.

• Session Controls: Configure strict SSH timeouts, idle session terminations, and multi-factor authentication loops to prevent abandoned active connections.

4. Operations, Ticket Resolution & Collaboration

• Workplace Collaboration: Align daily with the RDL Network Administrator to coordinate VLAN mappings, firewall rule adjustments, and routing protocols necessary for jump host access.

• Engineering Support: Serve as a technical point of contact for HPS design engineers having credentialing, shell, or connection issues when entering secure environments.

• Incident & Audit Readiness: Assist the Lead Network Architect in pulling audit trails and access reports during compliance reviews, system security audits, or customer security evaluations.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies


Required Technical Skills

• Linux Expertise (Expert Level): Mastery of Linux OS administration (Rocky Linux, RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) including shell scripting (Bash, Python), security policies, and package management.

• Secure Access & Authentication: Comprehensive knowledge of SSH daemon configuration (sshd_config), PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules) stack configuration, and secure local authentication patterns.

• Audit & Log Engineering: Proven experience configuring structured logging systems, syslog routing, Rsyslog, or Journald to create secure, immutable compliance audit trails.

• Access Technologies: Familiarity with Zscaler ZTNA (App Connectors), CyberArk vPAM, and Virtual Private Network (VPN) architectures.

• Virtualization Basics: Practical experience administering virtual machines, virtual switches, and storage within VMware ESXi / vCenter or Microsoft Hyper-V.

Preferred Certifications

• Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Engineer (RHCE)

• CompTIA Linux+ or Linux Foundation Certified SysAdmin (LFCS)

• CompTIA Security+ or GISF (GIAC Information Security Fundamentals)

• CyberArk Certified Sentry or Trustee

Soft Skills & Working Style

• Extreme Attention to Detail: Precise, systematic approach to system configuration, security rules, and audit trail maintenance.

• High Integrity: Uncompromising commitment to maintaining security barriers, compliance standards, and ethical handling of export-controlled hardware and software.

• Excellent Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, necessary for writing technical LLD/SOP documentation, explaining access gates to end-users, and coordinating with the RDL Network Architect.

Physical Demands


•

Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

•

Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Education & Experience


•

Bachelor’s degree in Network/System Administration, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent technical experience.

•

4+ years of dedicated experience in Linux System Administration, with a strong focus on secure system hardening, user management, and compliance auditing.

• Overall 14+years of work experience is required.

Notes


This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).

title: Resident Comfort Specialist
description:
$18/hour | Flexible Schedule | Meaningful Work

Greetings everyone. My name is Claire. I am posting here today with the hopes of meeting six people. The people who can be described as people with heart and people with passion but more on that in a minute.

You see, there is a story behind my work and this post and here it goes.

I am an educator and former school principal turned nurse, turned nurse entrepreneur and geriatric wellness expert. Yes, education was my first love and my second love is nursing.

If you ask my mother, she would tell you that I have never met a stranger.

I was that girl who would go down the street to find someone to help and would stop and carry the groceries for the elderly neighbor and feed all the stray cats and lonely dogs that I could find.

During nursing school, I developed a true inquiring mind, and I could not sit still because I was pulled by various areas of health care. I worked in a long-term care community and I soon became pulled by the emotional and psychosocial needs of most older adults who live in long term care.

Many of them are sad and although they are amongst others, many feel lonely and left behind. I made myself a promise that I would take interest in those older adults and find a way to make them smile and feel happy even if it was just for a short time.

Through all my work seasons as a former teacher, a school principal, a nurse, a clinical chaplain, and now, a nurse entrepreneur, one truth has never changed: people need human connection.

That’s why I started this program — to bring kindness, laughter, and companionship to older adults in nursing homes and long-term care centers.


So, here is where you come in. I am in search of people with heart, and people with passion. I call these people Resident Comfort Specialists, and their job is simple yet life-changing: to bring joy and comfort to someone who feels forgotten. The job is very simple and very fulfilling.

As a Resident Comfort Specialist, you might spend your day with a resident doing any or all of the following:

  • Reading or telling stories
  • Watching a favorite TV show together
  • Singing along to old songs
  • Decorating a small tabletop Christmas tree
  • Or simply sitting beside someone who needs company
And yes — you’ll be paid $18 an hour for this beautiful work. It’s a job that fills your heart as much as your bank account.

All you need are three things:

  1. A degree in compassion. This is supposed to make your laugh because there is no degree in Compassion. You just need to be kind and gentle.
  2. A clean background check
  3. Your ID and Social Security number (so we can pay you!)
We’ll introduce you to the care team at the facility, guide you through the process, and help you start making a difference right away.

If you’ve been looking for work that truly means something — this is it.
You’ll be paid to make someone smile.
And you’ll go home knowing you helped another human being feel seen, valued, and loved.

Come join our team of compassionate companions.
We can’t wait to meet you.

Please respond with a good phone number and an email that you check regularly

Thanks and wishing you a beautiful week ahead.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence, SIEM, EDR
description:
Job Description


About FIS


Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.


About the team


The Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) team identifies, analyzes, and communicates cyber threats that could impact FIS, our clients, and the financial services industry.


The team monitors the global threat landscape, including threat actors, campaigns, emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and industry-specific threats, and translates that information into actionable intelligence.


CTI partners across security teams, including Security Operations, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, and Attack Surface Management, to help drive threat hunting, detection, vulnerability prioritization, and proactive defensive measures.


The team uses intelligence requirements, internal security telemetry, commercial and open-source intelligence, and industry information sharing to provide timely, relevant intelligence to both technical teams and security leadership.


What you will be doing


You will serve as a key subject matter expert and partner across the organization, helping translate the evolving threat landscape into intelligence that supports proactive risk identification, detection, vulnerability prioritization, and defensive decision-making. This includes:


  • Provide technical and operational leadership for the CTI function, setting priorities, mentoring analysts, reviewing intelligence products, and promoting consistent, high-quality analysis across the team.
  • Drive the continued maturity of the CTI program, including intelligence requirements, collection, analysis, tooling, workflows, reporting, dissemination, and integration with other security functions.
  • Lead research and analysis of threat actors, campaigns, emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and TTPs relevant to FIS and the financial services sector, using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and structured analytic techniques.
  • Manage and optimize intelligence collection, including commercial platforms, open-source intelligence, information-sharing communities, and internal security telemetry, ensuring collection aligns with Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs) and stakeholder needs.
  • Produce and review actionable intelligence for technical and executive audiences, clearly communicating threat relevance, potential impact, analytic confidence, and recommended actions to support informed security decision-making.
  • Partner with SOC, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, Attack Surface Management, and other security teams to translate intelligence into threat hunting, detection, vulnerability prioritization, investigations, and proactive defensive actions.

What you bring


  • 7+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 4+ years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence or a closely related security intelligence discipline.
  • Previous experience leading or maturing a Cyber Threat Intelligence program or function.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex cyber threats clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Strong understanding of cyber threat actors, malware, attack techniques, vulnerability exploitation, and the broader cyber threat landscape.
  • Experience using threat intelligence, SIEM, EDR, and other security platforms to investigate threats and support intelligence-driven security operations.
  • Experience producing intelligence assessments and translating technical findings into actionable business and security recommendations.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, intelligence studies, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Bonus if you have


  • Experience working in financial services, payments, fintech, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience with commercial threat intelligence platforms, intelligence-sharing communities, and security automation.
  • Relevant certifications such as GCTI, GCIH, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent advanced cybersecurity/intelligence certifications.

What we offer you


  • Attractive benefits including private medical cover, dental cover, and travel insurance.
  • A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities.
  • The chance to work on some of the most challenging, relevant issues in financial services & technology.

title: SONIC RDL Network Admin
description:
​Technical Lead, IT Infrastructure
Req ID: 138373
Remote Position: Hybrid
Hiring Manager: Paul Stanners
Band: 10
Region: Asia
Country: India
State/Province: Chennai
City: Guindy, Chennai

Summary


We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented RDL Network Administrator to manage the day-to-day operations and administration of our global Research and Development Lab (RDL) networks. Reporting directly to the Lead Network Architect, you will be responsible for the run-and-maintain aspects of our isolated, air-gapped networks across multiple HPS Design Center locations (including San Jose, Richardson, Thailand, Shanghai, SongShan Lake, Penang, Chennai, and future sites).

This role uniquely focuses on cutting-edge open networking. The majority of our RDL network infrastructure runs on SONiC (Software for Open Networking in the Cloud) deployed on Celestica’s own high-performance network switches. Furthermore, security inside the air-gap relies heavily on Zscaler technology acting as internal firewalls integrated with local VLANs for precise, policy-driven access control.

Since this environment operates under strict security isolation without typical enterprise automated management tools, this role requires a hands-on, highly disciplined administrator who excels at executing manual and semi-automated workflows securely and consistently. Traditional Cisco-based networking skills are considered secondary to expertise in SONiC, Linux networking, and Zscaler-driven zero-trust security.

This role requires regular on-site presence within the RDL environment and participation in a 24x7 on-call rotation supporting global RDL infrastructure, including after-hours incident response and scheduled maintenance activities.

Core Responsibilities


1. SONiC & Open Network Operations
● SONiC Infrastructure Management: Monitor, configure, and maintain the health, performance, and uptime of Celestica’s proprietary open network switches running the SONiC operating system.
● Configuration & Segmentation: Implement localized VLAN adjustments, IP address allocations, and switch port provisioning within the SONiC environment to isolate multi-tenant engineering projects.
● Routine Maintenance: Execute hardware diagnostics, physical cabling checks, and SONiC OS/firmware updates following strict maintenance window guidelines.
● Secondary Infrastructure Support: Perform operational support, troubleshooting, and maintenance of legacy secondary network components, including Check Point 3980 firewalls, Silver Peak SD-WAN appliances, and Cisco Catalyst 9400/9200 switches as required.

2. Zscaler & Internal Security Policy Administration
● Zero-Trust Internal Firewalling: Administer and configure Zscaler ZTNA / App Connectors to serve as internal firewalls, establishing secure boundaries and controlling data flow across isolated local VLANs.
● Access Control & Identity: Provision local user accounts, configure role-based permissions, and manage decentralized credentials on Linux-based jump hosts.
● Remote Session Security: Manage secure engineer connections using CyberArk vPAM (Virtual Privileged Access Management).
● Security Auditing: Conduct weekly audits of active user sessions, ACL configurations, and local accounts to maintain an uncompromising security posture.

3. Data Transfer & Repository Sync Operations
● Multi-Tier Sync Execution: Execute and monitor the secure transfer of "transfer bundles" containing OS packages (Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, CentOS, etc.), drivers, and software libraries across the physical air gap.
● Repository Services Administration: Ensure repository services remain operational, synchronized, and accessible to authorized systems within segmented and isolated RDL environments.
● Integrity Validation: Verify cryptographic hashes (SHA-256 checksums) of all data packages moving from the Global Repository Server to the RDL Local Repository Server.

4. Support Ticket Resolution & SLA Adherence
● End-User Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for HPS design engineers needing open network troubleshooting, VLAN routing resolution, or new package requests.
● Ticketing Operations: Process, update, and resolve secure lab support tickets in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
● Escalation Point: Identify complex open-networking bugs, design deviations, or routing limitations and escalate them directly to the Lead Network Architect.

5. Compliance & Environment Enforcement
● Software Auditing: Conduct regular logical audits of systems within the RDL to ensure strictly banned corporate agents (e.g., CrowdStrike, Threat Locker, Big Fix, ServiceNow Agents, ClearPass NAC) are not installed.
● Asset Tracking: Maintain a flawless inventory of all HPS-owned assets inside the RDL physical rooms, including servers, switches, wireless access points (Aruba 755), and connected lab machines.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies


Required Technical Skills:

● Network & Security Hardware: Practical experience configuring and troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 network environments including VLANs, routing, ACLs, packet capture
analysis, and protocol troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump.
● Monitoring & Visibility: Experience with SNMP-based monitoring and alerting platforms such as SolarWinds, including device health monitoring, performance analysis, fault
identification, and capacity trending.
● Linux System Administration: Mid-to-senior level Linux administration experience including user management, shell scripting, package management, service administration,
repository hosting, and network troubleshooting.
● Access Tools: Experience working with remote access tools such as Zscaler ZTNA / App Connectors and Privilege Access Management solutions (specifically CyberArk).

● Virtualization Administration: Experience provisioning, maintaining, and troubleshooting virtual machines, clustered hosts, storage resources, and virtual networking within VMware vSphere, Nutanix AHV, and/or Microsoft Hyper-V environments.
● Air-Gap Protocols: Working knowledge of secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, SCP, rsync) and security scanning methodologies.

Preferred Certifications:

• CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)

• Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA)

• CompTIA Security+ or Linux+

• CyberArk Certified Trustee or Defender

Soft Skills & Working Style:

• High Operational Discipline: Ability to strictly adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) without cutting corners, even during urgent troubleshooting.

• Excellent Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, necessary for translating technical issues to designers and coordinating with corporate security teams.

• Multi-Tasker: Capable of balancing ticket requests from multiple global labs concurrently while maintaining accurate records.

Physical Demands


• Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

• Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Education & Experience


• Bachelor’s degree in Network Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• 4+ years of experience in network administration or system administration, preferably managing secure, segmented, or laboratory networks.

• Overall 14+years of work experience is required.

Notes


This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

• Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Support and execute monthly operating system and application patching cycles. Ensure critical security patches are vetted and pushed to engineering systems within a mandatory 24-hour window when required.

title: Resident Comfort Specialist
description:
Benefits:
  • Paid time off
$18/hour | Flexible Schedule | Meaningful Work

Greetings everyone. My name is Claire. I am posting here today with the hopes of meeting six people. The people who can be described as people with heart and people with passion but more on that in a minute.

You see, there is a story behind my work and this post and here it goes.

I am an educator and former school principal turned nurse, turned nurse entrepreneur and geriatric wellness expert. Yes, education was my first love and my second love is nursing.

If you ask my mother, she would tell you that I have never met a stranger.

I was that girl who would go down the street to find someone to help and would stop and carry the groceries for the elderly neighbor and feed all the stray cats and lonely dogs that I could find.

During nursing school, I developed a true inquiring mind, and I could not sit still because I was pulled by various areas of health care. I worked in a long-term care community and I soon became pulled by the emotional and psychosocial needs of most older adults who live in long term care.

Many of them are sad and although they are amongst others, many feel lonely and left behind. I made myself a promise that I would take interest in those older adults and find a way to make them smile and feel happy even if it was just for a short time.

Through all my work seasons as a former teacher, a school principal, a nurse, a clinical chaplain, and now, a nurse entrepreneur, one truth has never changed: people need human connection.

That’s why I started this program — to bring kindness, laughter, and companionship to older adults in nursing homes and long-term care centers.


So, here is where you come in. I am in search of people with heart, and people with passion. I call these people Resident Comfort Specialists, and their job is simple yet life-changing: to bring joy and comfort to someone who feels forgotten. The job is very simple and very fulfilling.

As a Resident Comfort Specialist, you might spend your day with a resident doing any or all of the following:

  • Reading or telling stories
  • Watching a favorite TV show together
  • Singing along to old songs
  • Decorating a small tabletop Christmas tree
  • Or simply sitting beside someone who needs company
And yes — you’ll be paid $18 an hour for this beautiful work. It’s a job that fills your heart as much as your bank account.

All you need are three things:

  1. A degree in compassion. This is supposed to make your laugh because there is no degree in Compassion. You just need to be kind and gentle.
  2. A clean background check
  3. Your ID and Social Security number (so we can pay you!)
We’ll introduce you to the care team at the facility, guide you through the process, and help you start making a difference right away.

If you’ve been looking for work that truly means something — this is it.
You’ll be paid to make someone smile.
And you’ll go home knowing you helped another human being feel seen, valued, and loved.

Come join our team of compassionate companions.
We can’t wait to meet you.

Please respond with a good phone number and an email that you check regularly

Thanks and wishing you a beautiful week ahead.

title: Resident Comfort Specialist
description:
Benefits:
  • Paid time off
$18/hour | Flexible Schedule | Meaningful Work

Greetings everyone. My name is Claire. I am posting here today with the hopes of meeting six people. The people who can be described as people with heart and people with passion but more on that in a minute.

You see, there is a story behind my work and this post and here it goes.

I am an educator and former school principal turned nurse, turned nurse entrepreneur and geriatric wellness expert. Yes, education was my first love and my second love is nursing.

If you ask my mother, she would tell you that I have never met a stranger.

I was that girl who would go down the street to find someone to help and would stop and carry the groceries for the elderly neighbor and feed all the stray cats and lonely dogs that I could find.

During nursing school, I developed a true inquiring mind, and I could not sit still because I was pulled by various areas of health care. I worked in a long-term care community and I soon became pulled by the emotional and psychosocial needs of most older adults who live in long term care.

Many of them are sad and although they are amongst others, many feel lonely and left behind. I made myself a promise that I would take interest in those older adults and find a way to make them smile and feel happy even if it was just for a short time.

Through all my work seasons as a former teacher, a school principal, a nurse, a clinical chaplain, and now, a nurse entrepreneur, one truth has never changed: people need human connection.

That’s why I started this program — to bring kindness, laughter, and companionship to older adults in nursing homes and long-term care centers.


So, here is where you come in. I am in search of people with heart, and people with passion. I call these people Resident Comfort Specialists, and their job is simple yet life-changing: to bring joy and comfort to someone who feels forgotten. The job is very simple and very fulfilling.

As a Resident Comfort Specialist, you might spend your day with a resident doing any or all of the following:

  • Reading or telling stories
  • Watching a favorite TV show together
  • Singing along to old songs
  • Decorating a small tabletop Christmas tree
  • Or simply sitting beside someone who needs company
And yes — you’ll be paid $18 an hour for this beautiful work. It’s a job that fills your heart as much as your bank account.

All you need are three things:

  1. A degree in compassion. This is supposed to make your laugh because there is no degree in Compassion. You just need to be kind and gentle.
  2. A clean background check
  3. Your ID and Social Security number (so we can pay you!)
We’ll introduce you to the care team at the facility, guide you through the process, and help you start making a difference right away.

If you’ve been looking for work that truly means something — this is it.
You’ll be paid to make someone smile.
And you’ll go home knowing you helped another human being feel seen, valued, and loved.

Come join our team of compassionate companions.
We can’t wait to meet you.

Please respond with a good phone number and an email that you check regularly

Thanks and wishing you a beautiful week ahead.

title: Before & After School Site Director at Morningside Elementary
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

When you join Champions, you’ll be supporting hardworking families and elementary-aged kids during out-of-school time, on school grounds. Whether you’re partnering with administrators to bring our programs to their district, or buddying up with students to aim higher, think bigger, and never give up, you’ll be leading the way toward inspired learning.

If you’re passionate about inspiring children and teachers alike to learn and grow, the Site Director role could be for you! Site Directors are passionate about educational excellence and empowering confident teachers. As a Site Director, you will use our nationally recognized curriculum as a framework to create unique and engaging classroom experiences. Site Directors are committed to making their site successful and know that important relationships with children, families, and their team are critical to success. Successful Site Directors are fully engaged, enthusiastic about their work, and eager to share their knowledge.

When you join our team as a Site Director, you will:

  • Lead and supervise a group of teachers to create unique and engaging classroom experiences, leverage and develop “best in class” educators to be passionate and committed professionals
  • Ensure your site is operating effectively; maintain licensing, safety, and educational standards
  • Partner with parents with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, school and district leaders, state licensing authorities, community contacts, and corporate partners
  • Lead recruitment and enrollment efforts of new families and children in our sites

Required Skills and Experience:

  • At least one year of teaching experience with the ability to develop, engage, and inspire a team
  • A love for children and a strong desire to make a difference every day
  • Ability to build relationships with families and staff and create a dynamic environment where play and discovery go hand-in-hand
  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, multi-task and manage multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific guidelines for the role
  • Be physically able to use a computer with basic proficiency, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors. Be able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits.

- Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

title: QA Specialist I

  • Ensure that exception documents and records comply with GMP, GDP and corporate requirements, and are closed prior to analytical testing disposition.
  • Review records related to deviations, change controls, OOS, and CAPAs related to Manufacturing and QCA/QCM.
  • Review in-process test results for executed batches and master filling records.
  • Review microbiology test data for release of raw materials, in process materials and final product release.
  • Ensure QC documents are developed in accordance with domestic and international regulatory requirements and corporate standards.
  • Ensure analytical data collection per 21CFR Part 11 compliance, execute data analysis, and verify data integrity.
  • Assist in Client/Regulatory audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Monitor manufacturing and laboratory notebooks to ensure issuance, review, and archival are conducted in a timely manner in accordance with established standards.
  • Review applicable environmental monitoring results, excursions, aseptic processing records, interventions and contamination-related investigations for documented assessment of potential product impact.
  • Confirm that relevant equipment calibration, maintenance, qualification and cleaning status, and applicable utilities or process monitoring records, have been addressed in the batch review package.
  • Work with manufacturing and quality control to resolve quality events in a compliant and timely manner.

description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. Job Title: Vehicle Inspector

Location: Fort Smith, AR

Department: Transportation

Reports To: Transportation Manager

Employment: Full-time


Position Summary:

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Vehicle Inspector to provide assistance to our Transportation programs by examining our fleet of motor vehicles for damage, missing parts and/or mechanical problems to ensure all vehicles are safe to operate. This position is also responsible for providing backup services to the Transportation department and assist with scheduling, when needed.


Key Responsibilities

· Vehicle Inspections: Inspect vehicles and key systems (including ramps, hoses, and mechanical components). Identify and report any issues to the Compliance Officer. Maintain inspection logs and ensure vehicle safety standards are met.

· Call Management: Answer all incoming calls related to transportation services promptly and professionally. Identify the agency and yourself, and ensure calls are handled efficiently and courteously.

· Scheduling & Coordination: Schedule transportation for both contract and private pay clients, when needed, using designated software platforms. Distribute schedules to drivers and assist with real-time adjustments as needed.

· Recordkeeping: Maintain accurate logs, service records, inspection reports, and other required documentation. Ensure all data is current and stored according to compliance standards.

· Customer Service: Respond to questions, concerns, and complaints from clients and drivers. Resolve issues when possible and escalate concerns to the Transportation Manager or Director of Transportation in a timely manner.

· Data Entry & Reporting: Enter and manage client data for program monitoring, compliance, and service tracking. Assist with regular reporting to support operational and regulatory needs.

· Process Improvement: Work with management to streamline operations, improve scheduling efficiency, and enhance overall service delivery.

· Training & Development: Attend all required trainings, workshops, and educational sessions to stay informed of policies, procedures, and safety standards.

· Compliance & Safety: Follow all safety policies and traffic regulations. Wear appropriate identification during work hours and report any violations or safety concerns immediately.

· Expense & Trip Tracking: Keep records of trips and any associated expenses, such as fuel purchases. Submit receipts and documentation as required.

· Additional Duties: Support the transportation team and perform other tasks as assigned to ensure quality service and efficient operations.
